chunks: And in the narration of al-Sakūnī, from Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from his father, peace be upon him:
That a man came to ʿAlī, peace be upon him, and said: “Indeed, my bondwoman has breastfed my child, and I have wanted to sell her.”
He said: “Take her by the hand and say: Who will buy from me the mother of my child?”
ai.seo_question: What did Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام rule about selling a bondwoman who breastfed her master's child?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a legal response from Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام regarding a bondwoman who breastfed her master's child. The wording indicates that by this circumstance she came to be treated as umm walad, highlighting a jurisprudential ruling tied to breastfeeding, lineage, and slave-status implications.
